text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working AI freelancer with 6 years of experience building practical machine learning and NLP solutions, and I’d love to help create your custom GPT-based chatbot for staff training.

Your project is a strong fit for my background in Python, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI API, Hugging Face Transformers, NLP, XGBoost, pandas, and machine learning. I understand the goal is not just to build a chatbot, but to create a useful training tool that can work with your existing materials, answer staff questions accurately, and deliver a smooth interactive learning experience.

For this kind of solution, I would focus on organizing and preparing your PDFs, Google Docs, and Word documents so the chatbot can reliably use them as a knowledge base. From there, I would build a custom GPT-style assistant that can provide targeted training content, respond to questions in a helpful way, and stay aligned with the information contained in your materials. I would also think carefully about how the chatbot should be accessed by staff, whether as a standalone application or integrated into your current platform, depending on what works best for your team.

I’m comfortable working through the full workflow of an AI chatbot project: document handling, content preparation, model and prompt design, response quality, and building an intuitive user experience. My goal would be to make the system both practical and easy for staff to use, so it feels more like a responsive trainer than a basic search tool.

I pay close attention to clarity, accuracy, and usability, especially when the chatbot is meant for internal training. I would aim to make the experience straightforward for your team while keeping the responses grounded in the training content you already have.

If selected, I’d be glad to help you turn your training materials into an interactive chatbot that supports staff learning in a more engaging way.

Would you like the chatbot to be built as a standalone tool first, or should it be designed for integration into your existing platform from the start?
